notes.title: 🚀 Update 1.5.1 - It's available
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43920788/3fdccfcb66a214330567b5321c6c891714b76af0.png

 UI enhancements providing even better visual experiences during gameplay.
 Switching the keyboard response scheme from Shift to Enter.
 Changing the color scheme of responses - swapping left with right (red with blue).
 Ability to change lobby type from the menu - private or public.
 In the lobby, we'll notice when someone has joined before the player selects a character.
 Visibility of the game version in the main menu.
 Bug fixes in questions.
 Other fixes for reported gameplay bugs.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43920788/e74c856f8a469cbc3b778cf979adfdf50a04e483.png

 Introduced a pool of new questions to existing categories.
 Changed the protocol in multiplayer mode from TCP to UDP, contributing to better stability and smoother gameplay.
 Added the ability to join online gameplay from a different region (may result in higher ping).
 Introduced time limits for category selection and aiming to increase gameplay fluidity.
 Now, in 1vs1 matches, a target will be automatically chosen to facilitate dynamic competition.
 Reduced the number of lifeline questions in the final round, with the last available one restoring 50% health.
 Balanced the dynamite competition to not last too long.
 Gameplay improvements to eliminate issues with players leaving matches.
 Improved bot behavior, resulting in a more realistic gaming experience.
 Extended the time for searching public lobbies to provide more opportunities to join games.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43920788/42c171964064f41a5adf2188a4287651fe089708.png
For your support and suggestions!

We look forward to further feedback from you to make our game even better.

Wishing you a fantastic time! 🎮✨
~ Team Simplicity

notes.title: Update 1.4.2 is already here!
notes.notes:
Hello Brainiacs! An update has just been released for BrainShow, with language corrections for questions from English categories, and now you can enjoy the game with your friends in local mode! An additional piece of information that I will give you is that the time until the update for multiplayer version is getting closer and closer, in which new categories will also appear! We plan for you to be able to face knowledge and/or hate each other during the holidays with your family :D

Change Logs:
- Added V-Sync, which is responsible for the frame rate limit in the game
- Linguistic corrections in the English version: reading of the narrator, content of questions, verification of answers and questions
- Camera position in the scene - there will no longer be railings in the foreground when the camera moves in the scene.

~ Team Simplicity

notes.title: UPDATE 1.4 IS ALREADY HERE! SPANISH AND PORTUGUESE (BRAZILIAN) ADDED
notes.notes:
Hello Brain Show community!
As promised, we come to you with 2 new language versions. From now on you can also play Brain Show in Spanish and in Portuguese (Brazilian).

Changes:

 Implementation of Spanish and Portuguese (Brazilian) languages.
 Language selection panel is now scrollable to display more languages.
 Rebalanced in-game category selection with bots.
 Redesigned the Steam Link help panel to more closely match the game's graphical style.


Fixes:

 Fixed bug with music fading out when skipping scenes.
 Fixed text scaling to make the UI look better with long texts.
 Fixed animation in the intro, where the presenter was taking steps unnaturally when entering the stage.
 Corrections in questions.
 Fixed several minor bugs.


The French version is still under testing, as we want to bring you the best possible translation. We will keep you updated once we know its publication date. 

~Team Simplicity

notes.title: Update 1.3.1 is here! We say "bye" to bugs, welcome skipping cutscenes
notes.notes:
Hi, Brain Show players!
We come to you with another patch update. Many of you have asked us to skip cutscenes - well here you go, download the latest update and enjoy this feature!

List of changes:

 Added option to skip parts of cutscenes when approved by all players.
 The panel informing about controller disconnection now only displays when the disconnected controller was involved in the game.
 The controller disconnection panel now disappears only when all controllers that participated in the game are connected.
 Players' names are now displayed in the lobby
 The appearance of the lobby has been redesigned for better readability of adding bots


Improvements:

 The end-of-game panel now scales correctly (the one with the rematch option).
 Podium now shows players correctly in all cases
 Fixed setting of players on the approval panel when we have more than 4 controllers connected
 Fixed a bug where the game could incorrectly assign a controller to a player when multiple controllers were disconnected and reconnected during the game
 Input of controllers is now correctly assigned when we started the game without a controller plugged in
 Fixed a bug causing the Steam Link help panel not to close when the back button was pressed while the panel was loading
 Minor graphical fixes
 Fixed many other minor bugs in the operation of the game


We encourage you to let us know in the comments here or in the community center about your opinions on Brain Show. This way you can influence the further development of our production. Thanks!

Team Simplicity

notes.title: Update 1.3 is here! Lack of friends to play with? The bots are coming!
notes.notes:
Hi, Brain Show community!
As promised, today we are delivering in an update the option to fill the lobby with bots. There is even the possibility to launch the game without a single player. Who wouldn't want to bet with their friends about which bot will win, right? This is just how we suggest such an idea.

List of changes:

 Added the option to play with bots
 Added a panel containing a tutorial on how to control the game with a phone using the SteamLink app
 Reduced the life taken by weapons in the finale
 Adjusted the amount of life points received at the rescue question
 Shortened the duration of the round with dynamite


Improvements:

 The volume sliders in the options menu can now be held down to change their value faster
 Corrected the font on some of the panels to match the rest of the panels
 Pausing the game no longer interrupts background music
 Improvements to the operation of the options menu
 Fixed a bug that caused the lobby to stutter when a player canceled readiness at the last minute
 Added button click animation in the menu
 Fixed bugs related to volume settings
 Corrections in questions
 Other changes and fixes



That would be enough. We encourage you to share your opinion and ideas, because every feedback is important to us, and it is an opportunity for you to influence the further development of Brain Show! Enjoy the game.

Team Simplicity

notes.title: Brain Show 1.1 update is here! Here is the full list of changes!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
We just released the first update to Brain Show. Below you will find a full list of the most important changes, fixes and new features:


 Few questions fixed
 Fixed the wrong audio track for several questions
 Fixed controller connection loss message errors
 Controller hints no longer disappear when changing avatar
 Fixed errors in answers and content in some questions
 Removed the camera when describing a category so that the entire category name is visible
 In each competition, it now displays what answers players have marked before the correct answer is displayed (in the upper right corner of the screen)
 The hint panel now displays the active player's control
 In competitions with reporting above players, control hints are displayed
 In the dynamite round, the presenter no longer adds inserts when the dynamite is fired
 Fixed a slight delay from when the answer panel appears to catch a player's answer
 The pause menu now works correctly from the start of the game
 Fixed a bug that caused the back button to launch the rematch menu after the end of gameplay
 Selecting the rematch option after playing a quick game now launches the next quick game, not the standard game
 The game now remembers the selected language after the first launch and no longer asks you to select it each time you launch it
 Adjusted the placement of items so that the longest names fit on one line
 After accepting readiness to play, players can no longer accept readiness again
 Other minor fixes


We are already announcing long-term support for our game, and you can expect more updates in the near future. We appreciate any feedback, so we will appreciate your comments in the comments section here, in the discussion on the Steam product website and, of course, in the reviews. Break out the brains!
